meta.title: Business email on your own domain · Clafina
meta.description: Mailboxes on your own domain, managed in Clafina. Read mail in Clafina or in Outlook and phone mail apps, with forwarding, out-of-office and spam filtering.

hero.title: Email on your own domain, run from Clafina.
hero.lede: Give everyone a mailbox at your business's name. Read it in Clafina or in the mail app on any phone or computer, and manage it from the same place as the rest of the business.

jobs.title: Your name on every message
jobs.body: Mailboxes like sales@ and amaka@ on your own domain, so every message carries your business's name.

jobs.title: One place to manage it
jobs.body: Add people, set their storage, reset passwords and see every change in one audit log, from the Clafina you already use.

jobs.title: Read it anywhere
jobs.body: Use webmail in Clafina, or Outlook, Apple Mail, Thunderbird and phone mail apps. They set themselves up from your address.

tour.title: Connect your domain in a few steps
tour.body: Clafina shows the records to publish, and publishes them itself if it already manages your domain. The domain goes live only when every required record passes.
points: Proves the domain is yours before any mail flows
Every message you send is signed
Recommended records let mail apps set themselves up

tour.title: Mailboxes your IT admin controls
tour.body: Each mailbox has its own storage and daily sending allowance. Suspend, disable or sign someone out everywhere, and keep their mail if they leave.
points: Aliases such as info@ and sales@ deliver to one or more people
A mailbox that sends spam is held until you release it
Every change, by you or a user, is in the audit log

tour.title: Webmail inside Clafina
tour.body: Mail sits beside your invoices, customers and calendar. New mail appears as it arrives, and an invitation goes into your Clafina calendar with one answer.
points: Recipients fill in from your Clafina contacts
Over the day's allowance, messages wait in Outbox and go out by themselves

items.text: Mailboxes on your own domain, with a display name, storage and a daily sending allowance
Aliases that deliver to one or more mailboxes and can be sent from

Each organisation's mail kept apart from every other's

connectsTitle: Works with the rest of Clafina

connects.text: Email sits with chat, Meet and the shared inbox your team already uses.
Invitations you accept land in the same calendar as your bookings.
Recipients fill in from your customers and contacts.
Use the same domain for your shop and your mail.

faq.q: Can I keep using Outlook or my phone's mail app?
faq.a: Yes. Mailboxes work over IMAP, POP3 and sending with a password, and most mail apps set themselves up from your address once the recommended records are in place.

faq.q: Do I need to move my domain?
faq.a: No. You publish a few records where your domain is managed. If Clafina already manages it, Clafina publishes them for you.

faq.q: Can mail be forwarded outside the business?
faq.a: Yes, unless your admin sets the policy to your own addresses only, or turns forwarding off. Spam is never forwarded.
Disable their mailbox. New mail to it is refused, and what is stored is kept, ready to restore or hand on.
No. An address that does not exist bounces, so mail guessed at random never reaches you. Use aliases such as info@ and sales@ instead.

faq.q: Can I send newsletters from it?
faq.a: Business email is for people writing to people. Use Clafina's campaigns for mailing lists.

cta.title: Put your name on every message.
cta.body: Connect your domain and give everyone on the team a mailbox at your business's name.
